dimensions.source: Edge and Coop, eLife 2020, Attacks on genetic privacy via uploads to genealogical databases
dimensions.limitations: Approximately 900 uploaded genomes could recover at least one allele at SNP sites across up to 82 percent of the genome of a median European-ancestry individual. This measures genomic information recovery, not directly authorization-boundary accessibility. D4 mapping is therefore under construct review and no quantitative D4 point score should be issued until that mapping is resolved.
